name: Apexart
known: The tax filing is under the name Apex Art Curatorial Program Inc, a 501(c)(3) exempt since April 1998, with Rand listed as president and executive director (ProPublica).

Programmes: the NYC Open Call and International Open Call, an Invited Curator series, an Unsolicited Proposal Program, a Franchise Program that stages shows outside New York, a one-month fellowship abroad, and publications (Wikipedia; apexart website; e-flux).

Finances (ProPublica, Apex Art Curatorial Program Inc): 2025 revenue $668,067, expenses $694,684, contributions $663,949, net assets $102,706; 2024 revenue $712,957, expenses $764,291; 2023 revenue $693,524, expenses $657,819; 2022 revenue $720,160.
ProPublica lists Steven Rand as president and executive director and Rosemary O'Neill as treasurer.
